hero.subtitle: Invest $545K (2M AED) and more in real estate and receive a Golden Visa for yourself, your spouse and your children. No employer required, no bank guarantee, no mandatory residency. Full freedom of movement.

items.d: Purchase of one or several units totalling 2M AED+. Ready or off-plan (50%+ paid). The fastest path — 30–45 days.
Off-plan purchase directly from approved developers (EMAAR, DAMAC, Sobha). The visa is issued once 50%+ of the price is paid.
You can build a portfolio: 2–3 apartments in different districts. The combined total must be 2M AED+. Ideal for diversification.
Bank financing is allowed, but your equity must be 2M AED+. The mortgage portion does not count towards the visa amount.
Your Golden Visa automatically extends to your spouse, all children (no age limit) and parents.
You can live outside the UAE. A single entry every 6 months is enough. The visa remains active.
UAE residents pay no tax on salary, dividends, rent or capital gains. Full financial clarity.
Open accounts with Emirates NBD, Mashreq, ENBD Private. Multi-currency accounts, investment products, premium cards.
Access to the best schools (GEMS, Repton, Dwight). DHA health insurance. Residents get enrolment priority.
Open a 100%-owned mainland company, a free zone entity, or a branch — no local partner required.

items.story: Was on an Investor Visa, needed renewal every 2 years. Switched to Golden — 10 years now, no employer.

items.q: Can I get a Golden Visa without flying to the UAE?
items.a: Most of the process is remote: property selection, deal via power of attorney, document collection. You only need to fly in once for 1–2 days for biometrics and Emirates ID.

items.q: What if I sell the property — do I lose the visa?
items.a: Yes, the visa is tied to the property. If you sell, you need to buy another one for 2M AED+ or switch to a different visa type. Owning multiple properties gives you flexibility.

items.q: Can I work for a foreign company on this visa?
items.a: Yes. A UAE resident can work remotely for any country, open a UAE company, freelance. There are no restrictions.

items.q: Does the visa include family members?
items.a: Yes. Spouse, all children with no age limit, parents. Each receives their own Golden Visa with the same 10-year term, under your sponsorship.
Visa government fee: ~6,700 AED ($1,825) for the main applicant. ~4,200 AED ($1,145) per family member. Our service fee is bundled into the deal.

items.q: What happens to the visa after 10 years?
items.a: The visa is automatically renewed for another 10 years as long as the property is still owned. No new tests or fresh application.

items.q: Can I apply for UAE citizenship?
items.a: UAE citizenship is granted only in rare cases (by special decree). The Golden Visa is residency, not a path to citizenship. But it grants almost every right of a citizen: business, education, healthcare.
